description_expanded: Nestled atop a pristine, sugary dune in the exclusive Old Florida Beach community, Shore-E-Nuff is a gracious beachfront retreat offering unparalleled serenity, coastal charm, and direct access to the Gulf. This stunning vacation home is tucked away in its own private paradise yet remains close to all the best that Scenic 30A has to offer. Step onto the back porch, where a private walkover leads you directly across the dune and onto your very own stretch of soft, sugar-white sand. Here, you can soak in the sun, wade into the glistening Gulf, or simply relax with your toes in the sand as the waves roll in. Seasonal beach service is included with your stay, providing two chairs and an umbrella set up daily just steps from your door. Need more space for the group? Additional setups are available at one of the best rates along 30A. For those who love the water but prefer a refreshing freshwater dip, a sparkling community pool awaits just steps away. Adding to its allure, Old Florida Beach is uniquely positioned beside Draper Lake, one of South Walton’s rare and protected Coastal Dune Lakes. These natural wonders, found in just a handful of places worldwide, blend freshwater and saltwater to create a thriving habitat for diverse wildlife. A private community dock provides a scenic spot for fishing, swimming, or launching a paddleboard or kayak onto the calm, glassy waters of the lake. If the tide is right, you can even stroll along the beach to the lake’s estuary, where its waters meet the Gulf in a mesmerizing natural flow. A Coastal Haven with Classic Southern Charm From the moment you arrive, Shore-E-Nuff captivates with its timeless Southern charm. Towering palm trees sway over the wide front porch, which features a quaint white picket fence and an upper-level balcony, evoking the elegance of a classic beach cottage with a modern coastal twist. Inside, the open and airy interiors are designed for both comfort and style, featuring plush furnishings, vibrant coastal décor, and large windows that flood the space with natural light. Throughout the home, festive Floridian artwork—including colorful schools of fish and a striking swordfish mounted above the mantle—adds a playful, beachy ambiance. The spacious living area is anchored by floor-to-ceiling French doors that showcase breathtaking Gulf views. Here, richly woven wicker-backed seating and plush cushions create a warm and inviting gathering space. The dining area, with its long creamy-white table seating up to ten, is perfect for family feasts and lively conversation. Nearby, the open kitchen features a sleek granite-topped bar with seating for four, ideal for serving cocktails and appetizers before dinner. Outfitted with stainless steel appliances and a Keurig coffee maker, this kitchen is designed for both casual meals and gourmet creations. Expansive Outdoor Spaces for Relaxation & Dining While the home’s interior is undeniably inviting, you'll likely spend most of your time enjoying the expansive Gulf-front porch, which runs the length of the main living area. With a cozy sitting area and a six-person dining table, it’s the perfect setting for al fresco meals, morning coffee, or sunset cocktails as the sky transforms with hues of pink and gold. A separate grilling patio below features a round umbrella-topped dining table, offering an intimate spot for grilling up the day's fresh catch. Just steps away, a private boardwalk leads directly to the sand, ensuring effortless beach access anytime you desire. Spacious & Stylish Bedrooms for Restful Retreats Two Primary Suites for Ultimate Comfort First-Floor Primary Suite – A serene king bedroom with private screened-in patio access, offering a peaceful retreat. The ensuite bath features a soaking tub, walk-in shower, and dual vanities, perfect for unwinding after a day on the beach. Second-Floor Primary Suite – This expansive king bedroom boasts breathtaking Gulf views, a private beachfront balcony, and an ensuite bath with a walk-in shower—an idyllic escape for relaxation. Inviting Guest Rooms & Additional Sleeping Spaces King Guest Room – A cozy space with front balcony access, where you can wake up to the gentle coastal breeze. Bunk Room – Featuring queen-over-queen bunks, this fun and functional space is ideal for kids or extra guests, with access to the front balcony. Bonus Den – Outfitted with a twin bunk and a queen sleeper sofa, this flexible area serves as a great lounge space or additional sleeping quarters. A Jack-and-Jill bathroom connects the king and bunk bedrooms, featuring a tub/shower combination for added convenience. This thoughtfully designed layout ensures privacy, comfort, and plenty of space for everyone—whether you're planning a multi-generational family trip, a couples’ retreat, or a fun getaway with friends. Exclusive Location with Easy Access to 30A Favorites Shore-E-Nuff is ideally situated in Santa Rosa Beach, just minutes from Gulf Place, a vibrant town center featuring quaint boutiques, casual bistros, local art galleries, live music, and seasonal festivals. Whether you're biking along the scenic paths of 30A, indulging in fresh seafood, or exploring charming coastal communities, you’ll find endless ways to make memories in this picturesque setting. Community pool (seasonally heated at HOA discretion) Private beach walkover for effortless Gulf access No golf carts allowed in the Old Florida Beach community A Beachfront Escape Like No Other Whether you're lounging on the sun-kissed sand, paddleboarding on Draper Lake, or sipping wine as the sun sets over the Gulf, Shore-E-Nuff offers an unmatched blend of privacy, luxury, and natural beauty. Book your stay today and experience the magic of Old Florida Beach! First Floor: Living Room with Patio Access, Kitchen, Dining, King Primary Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Soaking Tub + Patio Access, Hall Bath with Walk-In Shower, Laundry. Second Floor: Bonus Den with Twin Bunk and Queen Sleeper Sofa + Balcony Access, King Primary Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Balcony Access, King Bedroom with Balcony Access, Jack and Jill Bath with Tub/Shower Combo, Queen Bunk Bedroom. Based on the daily temperature and at the HOA's discretion, the community pool is typically heated during the fall and holiday weeks.
